chunks: The Prophet said: 'O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur'an as neglected.'
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about his people's relationship with the Qur'an?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia tafsir as a du'a of the Prophet (peace be upon him) or a divine statement, underscores the tragedy of the Qur'an being marginalized by its own community. It serves as a poignant reminder of the disconnect between recitation and actualization of divine guidance, a theme central to Shia reflections on the Ahl al-Bayt's role in preserving the true meaning of the text.
